title: listening_snapshot v1
description: Summary of one read of the listening sockets, emitted after their listening_socket records.

status.description: read; unreadable (/proc/net could not be read).

addresses.description: Addresses of the machine's interfaces, loopback left out: what 0.0.0.0 and :: expose.

processes_matched.description: false when sockets could not be matched to processes (the agent is not root).

systemd.description: read: unit states were asked; absent: no systemctl (containers, non-systemd systems); error.
